answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in jetty, verified in ferrous, and spiral names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 16 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 10 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
